description: This file defines the ProjectDetailedModel class, which models detailed information about a project, including its attributes, customer info, and project admins. It implements data serialization and normalization for API responses in a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: ProjectDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class to represent detailed project data for API serialization, including project attributes, customer info, and project admins.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Project entity into an array suitable for API output, including nested project admin details.
